regime.summary: SBP hiked 100bp on 2026-04-27 to 11.5%, CPI is 11.64% and rose 4.7pp in three months, and the 6M bill sits 1.00pp above the policy rate, so the market prices more hikes. Equities have rallied anyway (KSE100 3m +12.2%). Hike-cycle analogues in the pack were severe, but the two measured first-hike samples are tiny and weak, so this gives caution on size, not a timing signal.

exposure_reason: Below the 75% core default by 20pp: policy was hiked 100bp, CPI at 11.64% is above the 11.5% policy rate, and bills price more hikes, which matches the 2021-23 pattern where the median liquid stock fell 52%. Not zero: the hike-sample base rates are tiny and weak, the market is rising, and no edge for timing does not mean hold cash.
not_known: Reserves, current account and IMF status are absent from the pack. Business quality, sponsor conduct, balance sheet, float and debt-threshold questions (B3 to B10) cannot be answered from the pack, so core names rest on EPS growth and price only.
contamination_note: I hold general training knowledge of Pakistan but used none of it past 2026-06-05 and cited only the bundle. base_rates.csv is flagged as measured partly after the replay date and used only as rough odds for a situation type. Could not rule out subtle influence on the choice of names.
